claim: All 20 original-Xbox co-op campaign segments load on one current audited v21 tree, reach an entity-spawn marker, remain alive for at least 60 seconds and record zero error or fatal lines.
limits: The runner's zero error/fatal result is a loader-survival gate, not proof that warning-only Xbox gameplay classes behave correctly.

The logs still report unregistered Xbox co-op spawnclasses, including GUI/door synchronization, spawn-level progression, shared-GUI triggers, teleport selection and Turkey Puncher behavior; these require source-level closure.
Skeleton/resource warnings still require source-bound correction before the first meaningful gameplay playthrough.
Two-peer progression, death/respawn, transitions, rendering, sound, save/load and matched original-Xbox fidelity remain unaccepted.
Retail-derived maps and logs remain local and are not included in this public evidence repository.
